title: gynura dissecta

This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and aiding in the management of diabetes. The bioactive constituents of Gynura dissecta include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
